This downloads and runs executable yt-dlp code from the yt-dlp or yt-dlp-nightly-builds GitHub releases, according to your selected channel. It bypasses F-Droid review and update checks. Download only if you trust that source. This allows one update, not automatic updates. You can decline and keep using the bundled version.

This allows periodic downloads and execution of yt-dlp code from the yt-dlp or yt-dlp-nightly-builds GitHub releases, according to your selected channel. These downloads bypass F-Droid review and update checks. Enable only if you trust those sources. You can decline and keep using the bundled version, or turn automatic updates off later in update settings.
